styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small, tall anesthesia cart with a monitor on top and a pale body with drawers. It has about 4 lightness steps on the body and screen ramps, slightly fewer than the 5-6 on the stall and well references. On the measured facts it matches or beats the comparable references. It has 19 visible tones per 16x16 tile, against 17 for the cheese stall, 20 for the roofed well and 9 for the hedge. Near-flat coverage is 0%, with no large single-colour areas, and the drawers, screen and panel details add grain. Only 0% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline leans toward the tint of the neighbouring material rather than a black sticker line, as in the hedge and cheese-stall references. The piece is small and fairly clean, but it does not look thinner or flatter than the references at the same scale.
